definitions.explanation: The baseball club at a Japanese school or company. School baseball clubs are central to Japanese sports culture and the route to events like the National High School Baseball Championship ({甲子園|こうしえん}).

examples.japanese: {野球部|やきゅうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{野球部|やきゅうぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦キャプテン→キャプテン：00258_kyaputen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めていた→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: My older brother served as captain of his high school baseball club.

examples.japanese: {野球部|やきゅうぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{朝早|あさはや}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Baseball-club practice often runs from early morning until late at night.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧ (baseball) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (club). Most often refers to school clubs, particularly at the middle-school and high-school level.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野球部|やきゅうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to join the baseball club
- {野球部|やきゅうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}める: to quit the baseball club
- {野球部|やきゅうぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顧問|こもん}→顧問：16146_komon⟧: faculty adviser to the baseball club
- {野球部|やきゅうぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合宿|がっしゅく}→合宿：11901_gasshuku⟧: baseball-club training camp

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese high-school baseball clubs are famously demanding — daily practice, strict hierarchy by school year, and dreams of reaching ⟦{甲子園|こうしえん}→甲子園：23102_koushien⟧. The image of the {野球部員|やきゅうぶいん} (baseball-club member) is a stock figure in Japanese media.
